spans.s:
n. (-णं)
The internal and spiritual part of man, the seat of thought and feeling, the mind, the heart, the conscience, the soul.
E.
अन्तर् within, and करण an organ.

n. (-रं)
1 The female apartments.
2 A queen.
3 A palace.
E.
अन्तर् inner, and पुर a house.

f. (-तिः)
The heart, the soul, the internal nature or constitution of man.
E.
अन्तर्, and प्रकृति nature.

mfn. (-ज्ञः-ज्ञा-ज्ञं)
Acquainted with the heart, knowing one's self.
E.
अन्तर, and प्रज्ञा knowledge.

n. (-रं)
The internal and spiritual part of man, the conscience, the soul.
E.
अन्तर् within, शरीर the body.

mfn. (-ल्यः-ल्या-ल्यं)
Having some extraneous body, (a wound, &c.)
E.
अन्तर्, and शल्य a thorn, &c.

f. (-ज्ञा)
Internal consciousness.
E.
अन्तर्, and संज्ञा sense.

f. (-त्त्वा)
1 A pregnant woman.
2 Marking nut, (Semecarpus anacardium.)
E.
अन्तर् inner, and सत्त्वा having life or being.

m. (-दः)
An elephant.
E.
अन्तर् inner, and स्वद warmth.

mn. (-न्तः-न्तं)
1 End, term.
2 Final, ultimate, (continuing M. N. even with a fem. noun).
mfn. (-न्तः-न्ता-न्तं)
1

Near.
2

Handsome.
m. (-न्तः)
1

Death.
2

A boundary, a limit.
3 Certainty, ascertainment.
4 A limb, a member.
n. (-न्तं)
Nature, disposition.
E.
अम to go, and तन् Uṇādi aff.

mfn. (-न्तः-न्ता-न्तं)
Gone.
E.
अम to go, क्त aff.

mfn. (-न्तः-न्ती-न्तं)
Final, terminal, relating to the end.
E.
अन्त and अण् aff.

m. (-कः)
A name of YAMA.
E.
अन्त death, and क affix of agency. YAMA is the king or angel of death.

mfn. (-रः-रा-रं)
Causing death, mortal, destructive.
E.
अन्त, and कर what makes.

m. (-लः)
Time of death, death.
E.
अन्त end, and काल time.

mfn. (-गः-गा-गं)
1 Dead, departed.
2 Traversing, crossing, going to the end.
E.
अन्त, and ग who goes.

ind.
1 From the end, from the term.
2 Similarly, like.
3 In part.
4 Lastly, finally.
E.
अन्त, and तस् aff.

ind.
1 Within, between, amongst.
2 To the end.
3 Certainly, very well, a particle of assent.
E.
अन्त end, रा to receive, and क्रिप् aff.

(noun and adverb) n. (-रं)
1 Interval, intermediate space.
2 Period, term.
3

Clothing.
4

Covering.
5

Difference.
6

Sake, behalf.
7 A hole or rent.
8 Own, the self.
9 Without, except.
10 Without, outside.
11 Opportune time.
12 Midst, the midst.
13 The supreme soul.
14 Like, similar.
15

Other.
16

(In arithmetic) Remainder, difference.
E.
अन्त end, and र from रा to obtain, and क aff. In consulting the meanings of this word, it is to be recollected, that vocables which are adverbs in English, are often nouns of the neuter gender in Sanscrit; this word is also a pronoun, in the 3d and 10th acceptations. [] when the latter means, without, or out of, any thing but a house or town: the whole of the interpretations may be referred to the ideas of, within and without.

ind.
1 Without, except.
2 In the middle, among, amidst.
3 Near at hand.

mfn. (-ङ्गः-ङ्गा-ङ्गं)
1 Own, belonging to.
2 Internal, interior.
3 Of kin.
E.
अन्तर, and ग what goes.

mfn. (-मः-मा-मत्)
1 Immediate, intimate, internal.
2 Like, analogous.
m. (-मः)
A congenial letter, one of the same class.
E.
अन्तर inner, and डतम aff.

mfn. (-ज्ञः-ज्ञा-ज्ञं)
Prudent, provident, foreseeing.
E.
अन्तर midst, and ज्ञ who knows.

mfn. (-वः-वा-वं)
Of mixed origin or caste.
E.
अन्तर different, प्रभव birth.

mfn. (-स्थः-स्था-स्थं)
1 Internal, inward.
2 Separate, apart.
E.
अन्तर, and स्थ what stays.

m. (-त्मा)
1 The soul, the inherent spirit.
2 The internal feelings, the heart or mind.
E.
अन्तर्, and आत्मन् soul.

f. (-त्या)
A pregnant woman.
E.
अन्तर, and अपत्य offspring.

m. (-यः)
Obstacle, impediment.
E.
अन्तर between, इण to go, and घञ् aff.

mn. (-लः-लं)
Included space: also अन्तरालक.
E.
अन्तरा in the midst, ला to obtain, and क aff.

n. (-क्षं)
The sky or atmosphere.
E.
अन्तर within, and ऋक्ष a star; in which are the stars: or ईक्ष to see; seen by the world; the word is properly written with the long vowel, as अन्तरीक्ष, but the short is substituted in poetry.

n. (-क्षं)
1 Sky, heaven.
2 Talc.
E.
see अन्तरिक्ष.

mfn. (-क्षः-क्षी-क्षं)
Heavenly, celestial, produced in the sky.
n. (-क्षं)
The firmament.
E.
अन्तरीक्ष the same, and अण् aff.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
1 Dead, departed, concealed, lost.
2 Separated, detached.
n. (-तं)
Remainder, (in arithmetic.)
E.
अन्तर, and इतच् aff.

mn. (-पः-पं)
An island.
E.
अन्तर in the midst of, and आप water; आ changed to ई.

n. (-यं)
A lower garment.
E.
अन्तर inner, छ aff.

ind.
Amidst, among, between.
E.
अन्तर् with इण् to go, and विच् aff.

ind.
1 Except, without.
2 Amidst, between.
E.
अन्तर्, इण to go, and न aff.

mfn. (-डुः-डुः-डु)
Unprofitable, vain, idle.
E.
अन्तर amidst, गडु to drop or distil, and उ affix: what runs to waste.

Forgotten.
2

Intermediate, interposed.
3 Inner, internal, within.
E.
अन्तर् within, and गत gone, part. past. of गम.

n. (-हं)
An inner apartment.
E.
अन्तर् within, and गृह a house.

n. (-रं)
The stomach.
E.
अन्तर्, and जठर the belly.

n. (-नं)
Internal heat, inflammation.
E.
अन्तर्, and ज्वस्तन burning.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Inborn, inbred, innate.
E.
अन्तर्, and जात born.

n. (-नं)
The distillation of spirituous liquor.

m. (-हः)
Internal heat, or fever.
E.
अन्तर्, and दाह burning.

mfn. (-ष्टः-ष्टा-ष्ट)
Internally bad, wicked, vile.
E.
अन्तर्, and दुष्ट bad.

n. (-रं)
A private door within the house.
E.
अन्तर् inner, and द्वार a door.

f. (-र्द्धा)
Disappearance, concealment, covering.
E.
अन्तर within, धा to have or hold, क and टाप् affs.

n. (-नं)
Concealment, disappearance.
E.
as before, with ल्युट् aff.

f. (-र्द्धिः)
See the preceding.
E.
as before, with कि aff.

n. (-नं)
Profound inward meditation.
E.
अन्तर्, and ध्यान meditation.

mfn. (-वः-वा-वं)
Inward, internal, generated internally.
E.
अन्तर्, and भव being.

m. (-वः)
Internal or inherent nature or disposition.
E.
अन्तर्, and भाव disposition.

f. (-ना)
Inward meditation or anxiety.
E.
अन्तर्, and भावना meditation.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Internal, inner, being within.
E.
अन्तर, and भूत been.

mfn. (-नाः-नाः-नः)
Sad, perplexed.
E.
अन्तर्, and मनस् the mind.

n. (-नं)
Inward restraint, mental controul.
E.
अन्तर्, and यमन restraining.

mfn. (-मी-मिनी-मि)
1 Checking or regulating the internal feelings.
2 Heart-searching or pervading.
m. (-मी)
1 The soul.
2 Providence, the Supreme Spirit, as regulating and guiding mankind.
3 Conscience.
E.
अन्तर् within, and यामिन् who stops or refrains.

m. (-म्बः)
An acute angular triangle.
E.
अन्तर् within, and लम्व the perpendicular.

m. (-कः)
Superintendent of the women's apartments.
E.
अन्तर् within, वंश a race, and ठक aff.

f. (-त्नी)
A pregnant woman.
E.
अन्तर् within, मतुप् possessive affix, with an irregular formation of the fem. In the Vedas अन्तर्व्वती occurs.

m. (-मिः)
Flatulence, indigestion.
E.
अन्तर् inner, and वमि vomiting.

mfn. (-र्त्ती-र्त्तिनी-र्त्ति)
Internal, included.
E.
अन्तर्, and वर्त्तिन् what abides.

mfn. (-णिः-णिः-णि)
Skilled in sacred sciences.
E.
अन्तर् inner, and वाणि speech: containing the essence of all knowledge.

n. (-सः)
An inner garment.
E.
अन्तर्, and वासस् clothes.

n. (-नं)
Entrance, entering.
E.
अन्तर् within, and वि before, गाह to agitate, affix ल्युट्.

m. (-गः)
1 Internal uneasiness or anxiety.
2 Inward fever.
E.
अन्तर्, and वेग agitation.

f. (-दी)
The name of a country.
E.
अन्तर् between, and वेदी level earth. The Doab or district beween the Gaṅgā and Yamunā rivers.

n. (-श्म)
The inner apartments, the interior of a building.
E.
अन्तर्, and वेश्मन् a house.

mfn. (-सः-सा-सं)
Laughing inwardly.
m. (-सः)
Self-satisfaction, conceit.
E.
अन्तर् inner, and हास laughter.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Concealed, covered, hidden, disappeared.
E.
अन्तर् within, and धा to hold with क्त affix; हि substituted for धा.

mfn. (-वान्-वती-वत्)
Finite, having a term or end.
E.
अन्त and मतुप् aff.

m. (-सी)
A pupil. See अन्तेवासिन्.

Death.
2

A bed or mat on the ground.
3 The place for burial or burning.
E.
अन्त end, and शय्या a sleeping place.

m. (-यी)
1 A barber.
2 A man of a low tribe or cast, the offspring of a Niṣāda woman by a Caṇḍāla, whose business is to attend in places where dead bodies are burned.
3 The name of a saint.
E.
अन्त the end, अव and षो to cut, who pares the nails, &c. or षै to decay, णिनि aff.

f. (-न्तिः)
An elder sister, (in theatrical language).
ind.
Near.

mfn. (-कः-का-कं)
Near, proximate.
f. (-का)
1 An elder sister, (in theatrical language). See अत्तिका.
2 A fire-place. See अन्दिका.
3 A plant, (Echites scholaris.) See सप्तला.
n. (-कं)
Vicinity.
E.
अन्त the end, and कन् affix, इ inserted.

f. (-का)
An elder sister: see अन्तिका.

mfn. (-मः-मा-मत्)
Very near.
E.
अन्तिक, and डतम superlative aff.

f. (-ता)
Nearness, vicinity, contiguity: also अन्तिकत्वं.
E.
अन्तिक with, ता or त्व aff.

m. (-यः)
Contiguous support, (as that given by a tree to a creeper, &c.)
E.
अन्तिक, and आश्रय support.

mfn. (-मः-मा-मं)
1 Final, ultimate, last.
2 Very near.
E.
अन्त, and डिमच् aff.

m. (-सी)
1 A pupil.
2 A Caṇḍāla, or man of a low cast.
mfn. (-सी-सिनी-सि)
Final, ultimate.
E.
अन्त in the locative case, near or final; वस to abide, and णिनि affix: who dwells near his teacher, &c. See अन्तवासिन्.

mfn. (-न्त्यः-न्त्या-न्त्यं)
1 Last, ultimate.
2 Inferior, low.
m. (-न्त्यः)
1 A man of low caste.
2 A fragrant grass, (Cyperus rotundus.) See मुस्ता.
n. (-न्त्यं)
A measure of number, two Sāgaras, a very large number.
E.
अन्त, and यत् aff.

n. (-र्म्म)
Funeral rites.
E.
अन्त्य, and कर्म्मन् act; also अन्त्यक्रिया, &c.

mfn. (-जः-जा-जं)
Younger, latest born.
m. (-जः)
1 A Śūdra or man of the fourth tribe.
2 A man of one of seven inferior tribes; a washerman, currier, mimic, Varūra, fisherman, Meda or attendant on women, and mountaineer or forester.
E.
अन्त्य inferior, and ज who is born: born from the feet of BRAHMĀ; also अन्त्यजात.

mf. (-न्मा)
A man or woman of the Śūdra or fourth tribe, &c., see the last.
E.
अन्त्य, and जन्मन् birth.

mfn. (-यः-या-यं)
Sprung from the last or lowest class.
E.
अन्त्य last, जाति class, affix छ.

n. (-भं)
1 The sign

Pisces.
2
The asterism

Revatī.
2

The last star or constellation.
E.
अन्त्य last, and भ a constellation.

mf. (-र्णः-र्णा)
A man or woman of the fourth tribe.
E.
अन्त्य, and वर्ण a tribe.

mf. (-यी-यिनी)
A man or woman of low caste, especially one of seven classes: a Caṇḍāla, a Śvapaca or executioner, a Kṣattā or insect hunter, a charioteer, a bard, and a Vaideha or attendant on women.
2 A man or a woman of a particular caste living by the chase. See अन्तावसायिन्.

f. (-ष्टिः)
A funeral sacrifice.
E.
अन्त्य, and इष्टि sacrifice.

f. (-या)
Obsequies.
E.
अन्त्येष्टि, and क्रिया rite.

n. (-न्त्रं)
An entrail.
E.
अम to be sick, and त्र Uṇādi aff.

m. (-जः)
Grumbling of the bowels, borborygmi.
E.
अन्त्र, and कूज murmuring: also अन्त्रकूजनं.

f. (-द्धिः)
Inguinal hernia, rupture.
E.
अन्त्र, and वृद्धि increase.

m. (-दः)
A worm, ascarides, &c.
E.
अन्त्र, and द्यद what eats.

mf. (-कः-की-कं)
Included, comprehended, (in a class or troop.)
E.
अन्तर् and गण a class, ठञ् aff.

mfn. (-कः-की-कं)
Produced or occuring within a house.
E.
अन्तर्वेश्मन् and ठञ् aff.

mfn. (-कः-की-कं)
Visceral, relating to the bowels.
E.
अन्त्र an entrail, and ठक् aff.
